label: Отвечать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for отвечать (to answer).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Отвечаю' is the я-form of отвечать with the regular -аю ending. The verb governs 'на' plus the accusative, here 'на вопросы'.

missions.phrase: Ты всегда отвечаешь честно и прямо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Отвечаешь' shows the -аешь ending on the stem отвеча-. The adverbs 'честно и прямо' describe how you answer.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Отвечает' is the он-form ending in -ает. 'Отвечать кому-то' takes a dative recipient, here 'учителю'.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Отвечаем' is the мы-form ending in -аем. The idiom 'отвечать за' means to be responsible for something.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Отвечают' closes the present ladder with the -ают ending. 'На уроке' is the prepositional of place.

missions.phrase: Вчера я долго отвечал на письма.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Отвечал' is the masculine singular past of imperfective отвечать. 'Долго' stresses the drawn-out process the imperfective conveys.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Отвечала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'На вопрос' keeps the typical preposition-plus-accusative pattern of the verb.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Отвечали' is the plural past ending in -и. The dative 'профессору' names the person being answered.

missions.phrase: Завтра я отвечу на твоё сообщение.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Отвечу' is the perfective ответить with future meaning, promising one completed reply. 'На твоё сообщение' marks the target.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Отвечай' is the informal command formed from the present stem отвеча-. It urges an immediate spoken reply.
